The lever is PER-SYNSET-COVERAGE-BOUNDED, NOT transferable: complete a synset's edges and it answers; don't and it can't; the deterministic BFS does NOT INFER a held-out synset's absent edges from OTHER synsets' completions. BOUNDS the 'universal lever' as COVERAGE-COMPLETION-not-REASONING (the writeup's honest-scope; the empirical anti-over-claim).
